taskProgressAuthority: none (B30 Task state only as Observation input, not Goal Authority)
workflowProgressAuthority: none (B30 Workflow state only as Observation input, not Goal Authority)
detail: GoalRegistry是唯一的Goal注册中心、状态authority和Progress authority。所有Goal状态变更必须通过GoalRegistry.UpdateStatus完成，该方法自带RWMutex保护防止并发写冲突。
